opinions.point: Several commenters found the episode funny, charming, and unexpectedly heartwarming.
The comedy and character interactions were generally well received.
One viewer thought the series had settled into a good rhythm but felt some recurring jokes were becoming worn.
A viewer rated the episode 7/10, enjoying it overall while preferring the return of the franchise’s tank-focused material.

title: Magic Knight Rayearth (2026)

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the characters, especially Fuu’s intelligence and charm, the trio’s friendship, and the emerging romantic chemistry.
Mokona was praised for being more useful and endearing than a simple mascot.
The episode’s magical set pieces and selected still frames were viewed as visually striking, with some appreciation for its old-school aesthetic.
The story and character developments were generally well received, but one commenter questioned internal consistency in how magic-related items function.
Multiple comments criticized the frequent panning still shots and felt Fuu’s magic and some fight animation were less impressive than Umi’s or the older adaptation’s animation.
